explanation_short: KNN demonstrates strong predictive performance, evidenced by an R2 score of 0.8172 and a low MAE of 0.075, suggesting reliable model fit.
explanation_full: Observations show that the KNN model achieved an R2 score of 0.8172, an RMSE of 0.1132, and an MAE of 0.075. The high correlation (0.9073) between predicted and actual values further supports its strong fit. Interpretation suggests that KNN is the most robust model among the tested options, significantly outperforming DT (R2=0.5605) and SVM (R2=0.7324). The observed maximum absolute residual of 0.3672 suggests the largest prediction error, which should be considered when applying the model to new data.
